title: Transformer-Based Annotation Bias-Aware Medical Image Segmentation (TAB)
mechanism: A transformer with one learnable query per annotator extracts preference features, so one head outputs each annotator's segmentation. A separate term models stochastic annotation error.
adaptation: One query per source in a light transformer block at the U-Net++ bottleneck; each source's images supervise only its own output. Re-implement, because the repo targets PyTorch 1.7.
min_experiment: Arm = house PF + 5 source queries (5 seeds) versus house PF. Metric: crack IoU clean-49 and per-source CV. Kill if < +0.012.
evidence: R: RIGA optic disc/cup with six annotators; beats prior annotator-bias models (abstract).
